english.title: Knowingly permit the submission of controlled waste to a listed operation without a permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly permitted the submission of controlled waste, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WASTE..), to a listed operation carried out

(A)_[in or on land at **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..)]_
(B)_[by means of mobile plant, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLANT..), situated at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)]_

except under and in accordance with an environmental permit
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1)(b), (6) and (8) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes:
(i) This offence was substituted by regulation 73 and Schedule 21 Part 1 of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2007 - S.I. 2007/3538 refers.
(ii) Section 41(3) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 states that in relation to offences committed after the commencement of this section but before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, the amendment made by this section has effect as if for " 12 months " there were substituted " 6 months ".
(iii) Amended in accordance with Schedule 21 of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2007.

other.penalty:
Either Way
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £50,000.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 33(8) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
